lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَاهِيَةٌ is in the derivative form: وَاهِيَةٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ﻫ/ي   w–h–y crack, weakness, to slacken, to collapse, to fall down, to become frayed; to act foolishly. Of this root, وَاهِيَةٌ (wāhiyatun), occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
وَاهِيَةٌ wāhiyatun [fem. act. part.] frail, fragile, collapsing, in tatters

(69:16) وَانْشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ the sky will be torn apart; on that Day it will be so frail.
